onTheWay: On the way to the customer
noActiveDescription: When you accept a dispatch it’ll appear here

map.liveUnavailable: Live map unavailable for this order.

location.insecure: Location only works over https. Open the app from its installed icon so the customer can track you.
location.off: Location is off. Turn it on so the customer can track you and you keep receiving offers.
location.sharedWhileOpen: Your position is shared while this app is on screen. Navigating in another app pauses it — come back here and it catches up straight away.

turnOnLocation.dropoff: Turn on location to confirm you’re at the drop-off.

tooFar.dropoff: You’re {miles} mi away — get within {radius} mi of the drop-off to continue.

pickup.prompt: Required — snap a photo of the order at the restaurant before you continue.

tips.wholeOrder: Show the WHOLE order — every bag and drink in one frame.
tips.receipt: Keep the receipt visible so the order number can be checked.
tips.surface: Set it on a flat surface in good light — no blur, nothing cut off.

delivery.prompt: Required — snap a photo of the delivered order before you finish.

tips.spot: Show the food AT the drop-off spot the customer asked for.
tips.landmark: Include the door, desk or unit number so the spot is recognizable.
tips.light: Step back and use good light — no blur, nothing cut off.

photo.uploadFailed: The photo didn’t upload. Check your signal and try again.
